name: Jinki Extend Re:Vision
source:
Akira is a normal student who falls in love with his classmate Akao, who is also a miko of the nearby shrine. One day while walking together in the nearby forest, they come upon a mysterious container. They meet a man with murderous intent and a group of robots. This was an omen of the ‘lost life phenomena’ and the intense battles with the ‘Jinki’. Will they be able to survive this battle?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/11/04/november-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
晶是一名普通学生，爱上了同班同学赤绪；后者同时也是附近神社的巫女。一天，两人在附近森林散步时，发现一个神秘容器，随后遇见一名怀有杀意的男子和一群机器人。这正是‘生命消失现象’与‘人机’激战的前兆。他们能否在这场战斗中幸存？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/11/04/november-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
